content: FastAPI/Starlette session auth: use itsdangerous.URLSafeTimedSerializer directly (dumps/loads with max_age) to sign a small payload into an HttpOnly cookie set via Response.set_cookie(httponly=True, samesite='lax', secure=...); alternative is Starlette's built-in SessionMiddleware which auto-signs a whole session dict with itsdangerous under the hood. Both are itsdangerous-based.
